---
title: "Process no-flow data"
---


```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(cli)
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
data <- bind_rows(
  nanoparquet::read_parquet(proj_path("processed_dir", 'stiff_fin_noflow_data.parquet')),
  nanoparquet::read_parquet(proj_path("processed_dir", 'flex_fin_noflow_data.parquet'))
)
```

```{r}
data |> 
  group_by(fin, Amplitude, Frequency) |> 
  summarize(cycle_range = max(t.norm))
```

```{r}
data |> 
  mutate(fy_s.N = fy_s.N - fy.N_init) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = t.norm, y = fy_s.N, color = fin)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = trial)) +
  facet_grid(Amplitude ~ Frequency)
```

```{r}
forcedata <-
  data |> 
  mutate(fx_s.N = fx_s.N - fx.N_init,
         fy_s.N = fy_s.N - fy.N_init,
         tz_s.Nm = tz_s.Nm - tz.Nm_init,
         angvel.degps = (lead(angle_cmd.deg) - lag(angle_cmd.deg)) / 
           (lead(t.s) - lag(t.s)))|> 
  mutate(thrust_lateral(angle_cmd.deg, fx_s.N, fy_s.N),
         power.W = -tz_s.Nm * (angvel.degps * pi/180))
```


```{r}
forcedata |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = t.norm, y = thrust.N)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = trial, color = fin)) +
  facet_grid(Amplitude ~ Frequency)
```

```{r}
forcedata |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = t.norm, y = power.W)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = trial, color = fin)) +
  facet_grid(Amplitude ~ Frequency)
```

```{r}
forcemndata <-
  forcedata |> 
  mutate(halfcycle = floor(t.norm*2)/2) |> 
  filter(between(halfcycle, 2, 8)) |> 
  group_by(fin, Amplitude, Frequency, halfcycle) |> 
  summarize(peakthrust.N = signed_max(thrust.N, pctile = 0.99),
            meanthrust.N = mean(thrust.N),
            peaklateral.N = signed_max(thrust.N, pctile = 0.99),
            meanabslateral.N = mean(abs(lateral.N)),
            meanpower.W = mean(power.W),
            effect = meanthrust.N / meanpower.W,
            .groups = 'drop')
```

```{r}
forcemndata |> 
  mutate(Frequency = factor(Frequency)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Frequency, y = meanthrust.N, color = fin)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  facet_grid(Amplitude ~ .) 
```

```{r}
forcemndata |> 
  mutate(Frequency = factor(Frequency)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Frequency, y = meanabslateral.N, color = fin)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  facet_grid(Amplitude ~ .) 
```
